findings: Terminal close must contain start_marker_comment_id=5795782562 and its immutable server created_at.
END marker must be created only after the durable close checkpoint; worked_sec is then computed from raw END minus raw START.

If worked_sec >=1320 and other clean criteria hold, result is CLEAN_PASS_PENDING_WAKE; otherwise classification follows UNDER_TARGET/CLOCK_EVIDENCE_INVALID/NON_DURATION_FAIL/DURATION_FAIL_CANDIDATE rules.
No scheduler mutation is permitted during normal close because the wake is already prearmed.
